title: Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings to Announce Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Earnings on February 19, 2026
summary: Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings (NYSE: ASIC) (the “Company”) announced today that it will release financial results for the fourth quarter and year ended December 31, 2025, after the market closes on Thursday, February 19, 2026. These documents will be available on the Company’s Investor Relations website at https://investors.ategrity.com . The Company will host a conference call to discuss its results on the same day, Thursday, February 19, 2026, beginning at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time. Interested parties may access the conference call via a live webcast, which can be accessed at https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/640403362 or by visiting the Company’s Investor Relations website. Please join the webcast at least 10 minutes before the scheduled start time. A replay of the event webcast will be available on the Company’s Investor Relations website approximately two hours following the call, for a period of at least 90 days.
